intro: These questions help shape your meals, portions and exercise. Answer what you're comfortable with and skip the rest. Only you and the plan's admins can see your answers. Your answers are saved as you go.

questions.label: What would you most like help with?
Anything more about your goal?
questions.placeholder: e.g. fit back into my work clothes, get ready for a fun run

questions.label: How fast would you like to go?
questions.help: Slower changes are easier to keep.

questions.label: How much should the plan change what you eat?
options: Reach the healthy-eating guidelines from week 1
Build up to them over the 4 weeks
Keep it close to what I eat now
questions.help: The guidelines are the serves of vegetables and fruit a day for your age. Pick the last one if you're here for the planning and shopping. You can change this later and draft the plan again. For a child, an adult chooses.

questions.label: Age
Sex
questions.help: Used only to estimate how much energy your body needs.

questions.label: Height
Weight now
Goal weight, if you have one
How active is a normal day?
options: On my feet some of the day
On my feet most of the day

sections.title: Health
sections.warn: This plan is general information, not medical advice. Check your meals and exercise with your GP, dietitian or pharmacist before you start, especially if you take medicines, are pregnant, or have a health condition.

questions.label: Do any of these apply to you?
Any other health conditions?
Do you take any of these medicines?
options: Insulin, or diabetes tablets that can cause low blood sugar
Weight-loss or diabetes injection (like Ozempic or Mounjaro)
questions.help: Some medicines change what to eat or how to exercise. This only adds things for you to check with your doctor or pharmacist. Please talk to your doctor or pharmacist before changing any medicine.

questions.label: Which medicines or supplements, and anything you were told about food with them
questions.placeholder: e.g. warfarin: keep leafy greens steady. Iron tablets.

questions.label: Do you already take any of these supplements?
questions.help: Only tick what you take now. The plan won't suggest starting any. Protein powder is counted in your day, and the others add things you may like to check with your pharmacist or GP. For anyone under 18 they are noted but not counted.

questions.label: If you have protein powder, when do you usually have it?
questions.help: Leave it blank if you don't have any. It is counted as one scoop mixed with water (about 24 g of protein), in place of a snack. An admin can change the numbers to match your tub in Edit plan.

questions.label: Injuries or pain that affect exercise
questions.placeholder: e.g. sore left knee on stairs

questions.label: Has a doctor or dietitian given you advice about food or exercise?
questions.help: What they told you comes first. The plan works around it.

questions.label: May the plan writer read the blood test results you upload in My files?
options: Yes, use my blood test results
questions.help: They are left out unless you say yes. With yes, your newest results (up to 3 files) go to Anthropic when an admin drafts the plan with Claude or in a Claude Code session. The built-in builder and the other AIs can't read them. Your tips in the plan may mention what the results show, and the family can see the plan. For a child, an adult chooses.

sections.title: Support needs
sections.intro: Optional. Some people find meals and exercise easier with a few changes: reminders, fewer decisions, foods that feel safe, or less cooking. Skip anything you'd rather not say. Only you and the family's admins can see this.

questions.label: Do any of these apply to you?
options: Weak grip or limited hand movement
Use a wheelchair or mobility aid

questions.label: Are any of these hard for you with food?
options: Very hot or very cold food
questions.help: Meals and suggestions will avoid them where possible.

questions.label: What are your safe foods: things you can always eat, even on a hard day?
questions.help: These will be kept in your plan, and used as a starting point for anything new.

questions.label: Would reminders help?
options: Yes, remind me to eat and exercise
questions.help: Reminders go into your phone's calendar, so they work even when the app is closed.

questions.label: What would make meals easier?
options: Meals with only a few steps
Cooking a batch on a good day
Eating the same meals often (fewer decisions)

questions.label: Anything else that would help?
Allergies or intolerances
Other allergies, and how serious they are
Do you follow any of these?
Foods you won't eat
Foods and meals you love
What do you usually eat in a day at the moment?
questions.placeholder: e.g. toast for breakfast, a sandwich at lunch, pasta or a stir-fry for dinner, biscuits in the afternoon
questions.help: The plan can start close to this and change a little at a time.

questions.label: Kinds of food you'd like more of
What's breakfast like for you?
When do you get hungriest or have cravings?
Which countries' healthy-eating guidelines would you like your meals compared with?
questions.help: Pick one or more. The Macros tab shows the first one you pick, and you can switch between the others there.

questions.label: What do you usually drink?
options: Alcohol a few times a week

sections.title: Fasting
sections.intro: Optional. Skip this part if you don't fast. It is only about fasting you already do: the plan fits around it and won't suggest fasting to anyone. Apart from giving up some foods, fasting isn't applied for anyone under 18.

questions.label: If you fast overnight or keep a daily eating window, about how many hours do you go without food?
questions.help: Leave it blank if you don't. This only changes when your meals are suggested, not how much food is in them.

questions.label: On those days, when is your first meal?
How firm is it?
options: Flexible: I skip it when I need to
I keep to it most days
I keep to it every day

questions.label: Do you fast on set days each week? Which days?
questions.help: Leave it blank if you don't.

questions.label: On those days, what do you go without?
questions.help: These are left out for you on those days and not shopped for. The plan doesn't set how much to eat on a fast day.

questions.label: Will you be fasting from sunrise to sunset (like Ramadan) during the next plan? Which weeks?
questions.help: Tick the weeks before an admin drafts the plan, and clear them when the fast is over. The same food is kept and moved to before dawn and after sunset.

questions.label: Do you give up some foods on fast days or in a fasting season (like Lent or an Orthodox fast)?
options: No meat, fish, dairy or eggs

questions.label: On which days do you give them up?
questions.help: Leave it blank for every day.

questions.label: In which weeks of the next plan?
questions.help: Leave it blank for every week.

questions.label: What does a normal week look like?
questions.placeholder: e.g. work 7 to 3:30 Mon to Fri, school drop-off at 8:30, footy Saturday mornings

questions.label: Do you need lunches you can take with you?
Which days does work or school provide lunch?
questions.help: The plan won't pack a lunch on those days.

questions.label: Time for cooking on a weeknight
How often do you buy takeaway or eat out?
What can you cook with?
What exercise do you do now, and how often?
questions.placeholder: e.g. gym 3 times a week, walk the dog most mornings

questions.label: How much time could you give exercise on most days?
What can you use?
If you use a public pool, which days could you get there?
questions.help: Leave it blank if you don't use one. Swims go on these days.

questions.label: Exercise you enjoy, or want to avoid
What would you like the household to spend on food each week?
Anything else that would help?
